purpose: Connect four repository-owned questions as an upstream-to-field epistemic sequence without turning them into one software pipeline or transferring claim ownership.
spine: COORDINATE ADMISSION -> MULTIDIMENSIONAL STATE -> COMPATIBLE/REACHABLE WORLDS -> SURVEY PATCHES
surface: 何をnicheに入れる？ → flat mapが何を潰す？ → どのworldが可能/到達可能？ → どこを見に行く？
dependency_rule: chapter order is conceptual/epistemic; no chapter automatically validates, promotes, or technically depends on the preceding repository output

chapters.question: WHAT environmental dimensions earn admission?
chapters.current_state: scientific core closed; known-truth support retained; fresh empirical Product A ended empirical_confirmation_not_supported and not_promoted; Product B blocked
chapters.claim_firewall: environmental plausibility or known-truth recovery is not empirical Product-A promotion or a universal-driver result

chapters.question: HOW THICK / STATE-RESOLVED is the niche?
chapters.operation: x-y -> added vertical / temporal / structural / identity axes -> thickness, partition, state-resolved prediction and held-out transferability
chapters.current_state: N2 empirical chain scientifically closed; empirical lanes include thick-but-non-generalizing bat vertical organization, generalizing Serengeti temporal organization, and mixed BOP_RODENT state prediction
chapters.claim_firewall: thickness != transferable organization; added-axis information != causal mechanism; no N2 receipt automatically becomes an EOG world state

chapters.question: WHICH distributional / transition worlds remain possible and reachable?
chapters.operation: local possibility -> compatible worlds -> reachability / realizability -> robust / unresolved forecast
chapters.current_state: two favorable fresh heterogeneous paired endpoints support a replicated candidate general predictive complement; one valid third endpoint remains before paper-level closure
chapters.claim_firewall: compatible world != true history; local support != realized distribution; exact world identity remains an audit/update state, not automatically a predictive feature

chapters.question: WHERE can field effort be prioritized next?
chapters.operation: support/world evidence -> bounded candidate survey patches
chapters.current_state: validated Japanese 2.5% robust-support candidate-patch product; country-framed promotion failed preregistered gates
chapters.claim_firewall: candidate patch != occupancy probability != exact occupied site != guaranteed detection != route/budget optimum

handoffs: SDMR -> ODSP: coordinate admission -> consequences of flattening and added state axes
ODSP -> EOG: local multidimensional state/support -> compatible and reachable world sets
EOG -> ACSP: uncertain world/support structure -> bounded places where new field observation is worth attempting

field_contact.meaning: the first explicit survey-return interface in this programme
field_contact.safe_public_phrase: where to look first / candidate patches enriched relative to same-size random under the validated Japanese screening contract
field_contact.forbidden_phrase: where the species definitely is / guaranteed find

staging.promotion_gate: declare an independent question, inherited boundary, evidence contract, claim ceiling and terminal outcomes

non_handoffs: ODSP does not modify or rescue SDMR Product A
EOG does not require ODSP output and owns the historical ODSP topology component separately
ACSP does not require EOG and its validated Japanese patch rule was independently confirmed under its own contract
a favorable later chapter cannot retroactively promote a failed or blocked earlier chapter
284b is not a fifth niche chapter while it remains an undeclared SDMR v2.8.4 seed
